tools.name: get_week_rankings
tools.description: Return published weekly fantasy football rankings for one position, week, and scoring format. Each row has the player, rank, and projected points. Use it for a ranked list or a start/sit comparison. Basketball is not available.

tools.name: get_season_rankings
tools.description: Return one page of a published Ball Ranks season ranking board. Basketball results are nine-category, per-game rankings. Football results are projected points for standard, half-PPR, or PPR scoring.

tools.name: get_player_rankings
tools.description: Look up one player's published season ranking by player id or slug. Returns that player's rank on the season board, including position rank and projected points when football publishes them.

tools.name: get_player_projections
tools.description: Look up one player's published projection by player id or slug. Use scope season for a basketball or football season projection. Use scope weekly with a week number for one football week. Basketball has no weekly projection.
